title: Write a pump refurbishment model in PuLP from its formulation
heading: Write the LP File and Read It Before You Solve
cases: the plan saves the most a year within the budget, with the must-do station and one station of the bypass pair
the model has one row per rule, named budget, crew, bypass_<a>_<b> and must_<id>
the crew row adds up each station's crew-days, not the number of stations
a station that shares a bypass with two others is in two rows, and each pair keeps one station running
a must-do station is refurbished even when the money would save more elsewhere
